summary: Frontend retest of the iteration_15 fixes for the GENOVA Smart Algorithm (Playwright, genova.tester signed in with a Clerk ticket). ADMIN (role set to admin in MongoDB for this test, then restored to member and checked): Case 84 (wife Boy,Girl,Boy / husband Girl) shows 'Table case #84' and the outcome row 'Girl | 90%'. PDF case 1 (3+3, first child) shows 'Table case #1' and 'Boy | 70–90%'. In Sources, genova-smart-pdf is a plain SPAN with no href and no GitHub URL; it is the only source. The no_confidence_score limitation now reads 'Percentages are only those stated in the original source...'. The traditional_not_scientific text now starts with 'GENOVA Smart Algorithm:'. The admin print report title is 'GENOVA Smart Algorithm report' / 'تقرير خوارزمية GENOVA الذكية' / 'Bericht GENOVA Smart-Algorithmus', with 'Baby: Girl (90%)' and 'First child: Boy (70–90%)'. The source title, limitations and outcome values are translated in AR and DE. MEMBER: Case 84 = 'Girl', 'Stated range: 90%' (AR أنثى / النسبة المذكورة: 90%; DE Mädchen / Angegebener Bereich: 90%). There is no references block and no table case, and the API references array is empty. The member print report is correct in EN/AR/DE. The no-match case (wife Boy / husband Girl) shows the no-result-message box 'No matching case found.' with the disclaimer and no result card, in EN/AR/DE. REGRESSION: Blood type and Sex ratio Sources still render real <a> links (medlineplus, ncbi, ourworldindata). There were 0 console errors in both runs.

issues: Very minor: the genova-smart-pdf AR/DE titles leave out the PDF filename that the EN title includes. This is acceptable.
